messages:
noah_partner: Heads up team 164F 1A - NexaGPU listing blocked on AWS Marketplace. Procurement flagged two blockers: (1) PO routing failing because vendor tax ID on marketplace != vendor registry (2) export control clause in Nexa's contract redlines hardware export restrictions. Marketplace support ticket is `MP-1008811`. Can we triage?
anya_ops: Do we have the exact error when PO routes?
noah_partner: Marketplace webhook shows 422 for PO routing. Error snippet from ticket: 
```
error: vendor_alias_mismatch: received vendor_tax_id=NL998877, expected=US998877
action: PO routing rejected
```
leon_finance: If tax IDs mismatch that's a GL mapping problem. We either map the marketplace vendor alias to our vendor registry or ask vendor to update tax ID on marketplace. Mapping is possible but needs an audit trail.
rachel_legal: Export control redline note: Nexa wants clause restricting resale in sanctioned countries; marketplace MSA has a standard clause that disallows unilateral export restrictions. Nexa's language is broader and would expose Redwood to indemnity if we collect/pay. I need the proposed wording.
sam_eng: On routing side we can add an alias entry to the vendor_alias table so PO router accepts marketplace vendor_tax_id. Small change: 3 dev hours + migration + CI. Ops needs to coordinate for the DB change window.
nexagpu_vendor: (vendor) We can correct tax ID on marketplace but vendor finance team needs 48 hours. Regarding export clause, our counsel insists on explicit buyer geography restrictions to prevent gray-market resale.
leon_finance: If we map alias temporarily we must capture original vendor identifier in settlement metadata for audits and tax withholding. That adds an ops step for reporting.
rachel_legal: I can propose compromise language: add geographic restriction as an exhibit limited to resale, with Redwood excluded from downstream enforcement obligations. That should reduce Redwood indemnity exposure. Draft ETA 4 hours.
marketplace_bot: Ticket `MP-1008811` updated: "Partner Payments team: vendor alias mapping allowed pending proof of entity. Export control legal review requested by Partner Ops."
noah_partner: Proposed plan: (1) anya_ops coordinate 48h window for Nexa to update tax ID on marketplace (2) sam_eng prepare alias-mapping patch as fallback (3) leon_finance prepare tax/reporting checklist if we use alias mapping (4) rachel_legal draft limited exhibit on export geography + indemnity carve-out.
anya_ops: I'll ask vendor to update and set a hard deadline 48h. If they can't, I'll signal to eng to run alias mapping during maintenance window.
sam_eng: Scope: feature flag + migration. I'll allocate dev time tomorrow morning. Ops window 30m.
leon_finance: I'll prepare the checklist and a short memo on withholding implications and how it impacts distributor commissions. ETA 6 hours.
rachel_legal: Draft exhibit ETA 4 hours; will include sunset clause and require vendor signature.
noah_partner: If marketplace refuses alias mapping or vendor won't sign the exhibit, we'll need to escalate to partnerships leadership for exec exception or decline listing. Keep this thread live with updates. :up:
